description: JSON flatten / unflatten — Flatten nested JSON to path keys (a.b.0.c) or unflatten path keys back to nested JSON. An array of objects becomes flat rows with a union of columns plus CSV - handy for spreadsheets and databases. Optional: mode=unflatten, sep (default .), arrays=bracket for a.c[0] style keys. Max 200,000 chars. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_json_flatten
